ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark) pixel dominance across the visible surface; high-intensity (white) pixels are sparse and largely confined to specular glint from surface water and localized distal markers.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity distribution across the majority of the fluke lobes; no macro-level pigmentation mottling or large-scale geometric white blobs are detected.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Clearly defined V-shaped depression; wide internal angle (~135 degrees) with a shallow vertical pixel depth relative to the fluke's horizontal axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary visible along both lobes; frequent low-amplitude peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel deviations) creating a non-linear trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward curvature originating from the median notch and extending symmetrically toward the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white pixel clusters detected on the distal tips of both lobes, consistent with barnacle colonization or localized scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Physical irregularities and concentrated high-intensity spotting on the lateral trailing edges and tips of both lobes.
